scope: Build publish sheet minimal DangoUI runtime slice
decisions: DangoUI owns the visible field boundary and native input/textarea primitive; no double border.
DangoUI Button owns the save-draft hit target and its focus/disabled presentation.
Existing labels, section order, values and handlers remain host-owned.
Environment selector remains unchanged as a visual and behavioral control.
Theme translation may use documented DangoUI variables or scoped component APIs only; unsupported APIs remain explicit gaps.

responsiveAcceptance.390: fields and textarea remain fully visible and scroll above bottom actions
responsiveAcceptance.1280: no mobile rpx scaling, double borders or oversized controls
